elements.description: A structured, graph-based representation of enterprise data, codebase relationships, and contextual facts. It acts as the dynamic memory and factual grounding layer. (知识图谱，企业数据与代码资产的结构化图表示，充当 LLM 及其框架的动态记忆和事实基座。)

relationships.description:
Describes exactly how the core engine leverages those specific sub-components (e.g., using MCP to connect context, querying LLMs for reasoning, delegating to localized agents).

The Mechanism: Before or during a chat session, Opencode dynamically retrieves these skill definitions. When the user asks a question relevant to a bounded topic (e.g., "Review this React component"), Opencode injects the specific React Review Skill into the LLM's system prompt or context window.
The Benefit: It prevents the LLM from relying on generic training data, forcing it to adhere strictly to the user's custom coding standards, workflow rules, or architectural constraints without requiring the user to re-type them every time.

relationships.name: uses
relationships.description:
Describes exactly how the core engine leverages those specific sub-components (e.g., using MCP to connect context, querying LLMs for reasoning, delegating to localized agents).

The Mechanism: When a task is too complex for a single prompt-response loop, Opencode delegates the task to a Sub-Agent. The main process hands off a goal (e.g., "Find all usages of this obsolete API") to a localized agent loop. That agent runs semi-autonomously using its own bounded set of tools until the goal is achieved, returning a synthesized result back to the main framework.
The Benefit: Reduces context window bloat and separates concerns.

relationships.name: uses
relationships.description:
Describes exactly how the core engine leverages those specific sub-components (e.g., using MCP to connect context, querying LLMs for reasoning, delegating to localized agents).

The Mechanism: A user configures an MCP server (e.g., a server connecting to a PostgreSQL database or a GitHub repo). Opencode acts as an MCP Client. It queries these external MCP servers dynamically during the chat loop. It fetches precisely the context the LLM asks for (e.g., table schemas) and bridges it into the LLM's context window.
The Benefit: Extensibility. Users can write their own MCP servers in any language to connect Opencode to proprietary enterprise systems without altering Opencode's core codebase.

relationships.name: uses
relationships.description:
Describes exactly how the core engine leverages those specific sub-components (e.g., using MCP to connect context, querying LLMs for reasoning, delegating to localized agents).

The Mechanism: Opencode translates the schema of available tools into a JSON format the LLM natively understands (OpenAI Tool Calling / Anthropic Tool Use). When the LLM outputs a command like {"name": "run_in_terminal", "args": {"cmd": "npm install"}}, Opencode catches this JSON payload, executes the physical action on the user's operating system, captures the stdout/stderr, and sends the text output back to the LLM to continue reasoning.
